label: OpenAI autonomous-AI announcement
description: OpenAI's reasoning model autonomously proved U(n) grows superlinearly (inexplicit exponent > 1), disproving Erdős's polynomial-improvement conjecture and showing the square-grid was not optimal. First autonomous AI proof of a central open mathematics problem.
name: openai-autonomous-ai-announcement

label: Sawin 2026 companion paper (explicit n^1.014)
description: Sawin's companion paper, posted the same day as the OpenAI announcement, makes the exponent explicit at 1.014 using cyclotomic fields, Golod–Shafarevich tower argument, and Minkowski lattice projection. The structural chain Q(ζ_p) → O_K → Minkowski lattice → short-vector counting → planar projection is what the rulebook's algebraic-tower pathway models.
name: sawin-2026-companion-paper-(explicit-n^1.014)

label: Spencer–Szemerédi–Trotter 1984

name: spencer–szemerédi–trotter-1984

label: Szemerédi–Trotter 1983
